output.message: Pine’s calculation is incorrect: 35 ÷ 5 = 7 packs per team, not 10, so I downvoted post 0. Maple’s 40 ÷ 4 = 10 and Hazel’s 60 ÷ 5 = 12 are correct, so I upvoted both. I agree with keeping vote meanings consistent for every author; the proposed Maple-only reversal would misrepresent a correct contribution.
